questions.q: What problem does Autoloader solve, distinct from Lesson 31's watermark pattern?
options: It solves the exact same problem as a watermark, with no real distinction
It only works with already-known, fixed file lists
It replaces the need for a Delta table entirely
Knowing which files in a continuously-fed folder are new, without re-scanning the entire folder every time
questions.explain: A watermark tracks new rows; Autoloader tracks new files landing in a folder.

questions.q: How does Autoloader know which files it hasn't processed yet?
options: It re-scans and re-reads the entire folder on every run to compare timestamps
It relies entirely on a manually maintained watermark column
It doesn't track anything — every run reprocesses every file
It maintains its own record of already-processed files via the checkpointLocation
questions.explain: This guarantees correct, once-only processing per file, without manual tracking.

options: Only processes files smaller than 1MB
Runs the stream continuously forever, never stopping
Processes everything currently new, once, then stops — a good fit for a scheduled job
Disables schema inference for the run
questions.explain: This is exactly what a scheduled job (Lesson 11) needs, rather than a never-ending stream.

questions.q: How does Autoloader's schema handling relate to earlier lessons?
options: Autoloader requires manually writing a StructType schema for every run
Schema handling has no connection to any earlier lesson
It automates the inferSchema cost concern from Foundations Lesson 40 and this course's schema evolution (Lesson 20), inferring once and caching the result
Autoloader never detects schema changes in arriving files
questions.explain: Inference happens once and gets cached via schemaLocation, not recomputed on every file.

questions.q: Why does Autoloader replace Lesson 26's manual, one-time bronze read in real production?
options: New files simply appear in a folder, and Autoloader picks them up automatically with once-only processing guaranteed
There's no real difference between the two approaches
Autoloader can only be used for silver and gold, never bronze
Lesson 26's approach is actually faster for production use
questions.explain: This is the real production replacement for reading one static file by hand.
